messages:
Alex C: Evening handoff — I'm oncall until 10pm PT. TL;DR: canary deploy happened, watch embeddings latency and the gpu-pool kernel patch later tonight.

Alex C: What changed:
- model-gateway v2.3.1 rolled to canary (10% traffic) at 18:30 PT — routing rules updated.
- We kept prod batcher max_batch=64 (we tested rollback on staging to 32 and saw increased p95).
- infra: kernel patch scheduled for gpu-pool-3 at 23:00 UTC (drain + reboot). Ops will cordon nodes.

Alex C: What to watch:
- embeddings p50/p95 in eu-west and us-west — see metric inference.embedding.latency.{p50,p95}.
- queue length for batcher (token_queue_depth > 1500 is bad).
- model-gateway error_rate spike > 0.5% — fallback to v2.2.9 configured.

Maria T: noted. I'll keep an eye on eu-west. If embeddings p95 > 300ms for 3 consecutive windows, scale up batcher by +1.

Chen W: small FYI — we saw one noisy alert during canary about KV cache misses for llama-7b-quant. Likely due to warmup. Ignore unless error_rate accompanies it.

Samir: pinging infra to confirm drain schedule. @Lia P can you confirm patch window and AMs on call?

Lia P: Confirmed. Kernel patch window is 23:00-23:45 UTC. Ops will rotate nodes one at a time; expected 3-5 min for each reboot. I'll be online for the first two nodes.

Alex C: Quick runbook snippets — if batcher queue > 1500 do:
```
# scale replica in cluster-alpha
kubectl scale deploy/batcher --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy batcher -o jsonpath='{.status.replicas}')+1)) -n inference
```
If model-gateway error_rate > 0.5% for 10m, run rollback:
```
# rollback gateway to v2.2.9
kubectl set image deploy/model-gateway model-gateway=redwood/model-gateway:v2.2.9 -n inference
```

Maria T: added alert annotations and reduced noisy alert to INFO for kv-cache-miss.

Oncall Bot: [alert] inference.embedding.latency.p95 eu-west = 312ms (threshold 300ms) — triggered at 18:47:12 UTC.

Alex C: seeing the p95 blip now. Maria, thanks. If it stays >300ms for two more windows I'll start a scale.

Chen W: if scaling doesn't look effective in 10m, try forcing a cache-warm call for top 5 customer prefixes (I can provide list).

Samir: infra confirms cordon/drain commands will use safe-drain script; I'll watch for evictions.

Lia P: escalation path: if gpu-pool-3 drain leads to >5% capacity loss or we see degraded SLAs, page SRE lead and start fallback to dedicated-region routing.

Alex C: Action items before I sign off:
- Maria: watch eu-west p95 and scale if needed.
- Samir: confirm drain start and post updates in this thread.
- Lia: standby for escalation during node reboots.
- Chen: prep warmup prefixes if scale doesn't help.

Alex C: Leaving a short checklist in case I need to jump back:
- check token queue depth dash (ops/dash > batcher queue)
- check model-gateway canary traffic % (should be 10%)
- watch for error_rate and roll back if >0.5% sustained

Maria T: Got it. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

Samir: drain starting in ~5m, will post status updates.

Oncall Bot: [info] drain job started on node gpu-node-3a at 22:59:55 UTC by infra/automation.

Alex C: Thanks team — I'll be reachable if anything spikes. Good handoff.
